package.description: Generates and displays long-term spectral averages of audio data.

en-US.description: Generates and displays long-term spectral averages of audio data.
en-US.longDescription: Raven Expedition is a free tool for generating and viewing long-term spectral averages (LTSA). It helps visualize long durations of audio data to identify patterns and areas of interest in passive acoustic monitoring datasets.
en-US.name: Raven Expedition

zh-CN.description: 用于生成和查看音频数据的长期谱平均值。
zh-CN.longDescription: Raven Expedition 是一款用于生成和查看长期谱平均值（LTSA）的免费工具。它可将长时间跨度的音频数据可视化，以识别被动声学监测数据集中的模式和关注区域。
